name: Kindan no Sekai e 3 Atarashii Deai
original_name: 禁断の世界へ3 新しい出会い
source:
An honors student named Yuma discovered the world of exhibitionism.
Unable to forget the sensuality of being naked in public, she goes too far.

Previously, Yuma exposed herself in a way that drew unwanted attention.
One man who made her uncomfortable has shown up again.
But more than that, Yuma is shocked to meet a new person presenting a new problem... 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE085031.html]DLsite English[/url]]
